guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-climb.text: If the player has done The Fremennik Trials:

steps.player: Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!

steps.npc: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-climb.text: If the player has not done The Fremennik Trials:

steps.npc: Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-climb.npc: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
Just remember that I'm watching you.
Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.npc: Hey, how did you get here?

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.player: Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.npc: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.player: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.npc: If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.

guard-at-entrance-to-mountain-camp-talki.player: Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?

guard-in-the-mountain-camp.npc: Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
